result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. Every contributor is now listed, and the "The list is limited to N items" note is gone.

Changes, in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `limit` read and the `.limit(...)` call in `saveContributorsTable`, which feeds `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, the bots page and the teams pages. Also removed the paragraph that printed the "limited to" note. Sort order is unchanged.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on `recentContributors` in the bar chart code, so there is one bar per recently active contributor.

The `contributorsListLimit` field and its getter/setter in `LandscapeConfiguration.java` are untouched, so existing config files still parse. Nothing reads it any more.

Verification: `mvn -o -pl reports compile` succeeded, and `mvn -o -pl reports test` completed with no failures. No existing test covers the contributor report, so the output itself is unverified; I did not generate a landscape report to inspect it. Nothing is committed.
